say:2:1321307001:1.text: These fish seem to be doing well! It's so delightful to see them swimming happily. I have a good feeling about this! It might really help the Frozen Paw. My instincts are rarely wrong, you know!
say:2:1321307001:1.source_cn: 这些小家伙放到温泉里还是活蹦乱跳的，看着让人高兴！我有...

say:3:1321307002:1.text: They seem to be adapting well so far!
say:3:1321307002:1.source_cn: 是啊，它们暂时都没出现不适应环境的情况，真是件好事！

say:6:1321307003:1.text: However, it'll take time to see which species adapts the best.
say:6:1321307003:1.source_cn: 不过，具体哪几种才更适合在温泉中饲养，恐怕得观察一阵子...

say:7:1321307004:1.text: I'll stay here to monitor them carefully, so there's no need to worry.
say:7:1321307004:1.source_cn: 放心吧，亲爱的。我本来就打算留在这里观察它们的，不用担...

say:8:1321307005:1.text: However, that means I can't make my usual trip to Cedartown. Sweetheart, could I trouble you again?
say:8:1321307005:1.source_cn: 不过这样一来，我就抽不出时间去雪松镇了。

say:9:1321307006:1.text: There's a merchant named <style="highlight">Varon</style> on the <style="highlight">west side of town</style>. He handles my supplies, but his latest delivery is running two days late. Could you check in on him for me?

say:10:1321307007:1.text: If the delay drags on, we really might run out of food for the guests.
say:10:1321307007:1.source_cn: 要是再晚两三天，白熊旅店就真没食物招待客人了。这可是很...

say:13:1321307008:1.text: That won't do! Chippy's still waiting for Madam Gerda's special meal!
say:13:1321307008:1.source_cn: 那可不行！满满还等着吃格尔达女士做的美食呢！

say:14:1321307009:1.text: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!
say:14:1321307009:1.source_cn: 主人，为了美食！再次出发吧！
say:14:1321307009:1.male: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!
say:14:1321307009:1.female: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!
